identity: University of Groningen (Rijksuniversiteit Groningen), BSc Sociologie, Dutch-taught 180 EC ordinary degree, RIO 56601, registry row 221. The dated regulations also specify a short list of English-taught units.
sourceUse: Programme-specific 2026–2027 OER pp. 4–6 and 8 govern the ordinary curriculum and formal sequence. The public degree page substantiates identity and recognised fields. The dated Ocasys course payloads substantiate selected content and credit relationships. Use the first listed second-year field and its linked project, then the first different third-year field without reference to UCR fit.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Introduction to Sociology
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Introduces sociology and macro–micro–macro explanations of social problems.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Social networks
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Teaches network theory and formal analysis of relationships.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Project: social networks
catalogueCorroboration.finding: The 10 EC project is listed with the corresponding field in the regulations.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Sociology of labour
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Uses paid and unpaid work and its regulation to explain social structure and inequality.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Project: Neighborhoods and Values
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Studies norms, social cohesion and safety across neighbourhoods. The formal prerequisites come from the regulations.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Bachelor Thesis
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Independent supervised sociological research and reporting.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Sociology of Criminality and Safety
catalogueCorroboration.finding: The crime and safety field studies antisocial behaviour, social bonds and interventions.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Advanced Statistics
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Extends multiple regression including logistic models and applies it to thesis research.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Statistics 3
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Uses analysis of variance and covariance and logistic models.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Methodologie en dataverzameling
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Introduces the empirical research cycle and collection of social research data.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Statistics 2
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Develops linear regression after introductory inference.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Organisation and Society
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Connects organisational forms and behaviour with contemporary societies.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Theories of Society
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Uses social-science books and theory to assess debates on class inequality.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Social and institutional change
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Compares theories of social and institutional change.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Welfare Sociology
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Compares sociological and economic perspectives on social welfare.

components: Compulsory first-year study groups across the full academic year.
Selected as the first listed year-two field course in the formal programme-specific regulations.
Selected to correspond with the Social Networks field course, as the regulations require.
Compulsory independent bachelor thesis; admission requires completion of the first-year curriculum and all projects.
Selected as the first listed year-three field course not already taken in year two.
One or two university minors, or an approved personal broadening minor outside Sociology; retained as genuine choice space.

progression.year-two: Pass at least two of three first-year statistics units before Project Waarden en Wijken. Pair the field course with its 10 EC project.
progression.year-three: The selected field must differ from the year-two field. The 30 EC broadening minor can comprise one or two eligible university minors or a personally assembled option requiring prior approval.
progression.thesis: Complete all first-year units and all projects before starting Bachelorwerkstuk.
